drivingQuestion: How can Rava permit salting fish that cannot be eaten on the Festival?
outcomeNote: In both versions Rava answers Abaye's objection

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ אַבָּיֵי, וְהָא תְּנַן: כְּבָשִׁין שֶׁהוּא יָכוֹל לֶאֱכוֹל מֵהֶן בַּמּוֹעֵד — כּוֹבְשָׁן! אֲמַר לֵיהּ: כֵּיוָן דְּמֵעִיקָּרָא אַדַּעְתָּא דַאֲכִילָה אַיְיתִינְהוּ, וְאִי שָׁבֵיק לְהוּ פָּסְדִי, כִּפְרַקְמַטְיָא הָאָבֵד דָּמֵי, וּשְׁרֵי.
segments.en: «Abaye said to him: Didn’t we learn» in the mishna: With regard to «all preserved food from which he can eat on the Festival, he» may «preserve them» on the intermediate days of a Festival? In this case it was impossible to eat that much fish on the Festival, and therefore preserving them should have been prohibited. Rava «said to him: Since they initially brought» these fish «with the intention of eating» them on the Festival, and it only became clear afterward that they had brought too many, «and if one would leave them» without salting them «they would be ruined, they are» treated «like merchandise that will be lost, and» therefore preserving them «is permitted.»

segments.he: וְאִיכָּא דְּאָמְרִי, שְׁרָא לְהוּ רָבָא מֵיצָד מֵיזָל אַיְיתוֹיֵי וּמִימְלָח. אֲמַר לֵיהּ אַבָּיֵי: וְהָא אֲנַן, כְּבָשִׁין שֶׁהוּא יָכוֹל לֶאֱכוֹל מֵהֶן כּוֹבְשָׁן תְּנַן!
segments.en: «And some say» that it did not happen in this manner, rather, «Rava permitted them to trap» the fish, «to bring them» home, «and to salt» them. «Abaye said to him: Didn’t we learn» in the mishna: With regard to «all preserved food from which he can eat on the Festival, he» may «preserve them» on the intermediate days of a Festival? These fish were heavily salted and consequently could not be eaten until they thoroughly dried out.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: הָנֵי נָמֵי מִיתְאַכְלִי אַגַּב אִיצָצָא. כִּי הָא דִּשְׁמוּאֵל עֲבַדוּ לֵיהּ שִׁיתִּין אִיצָצֵי וַאֲכַל. רָבָא אִיקְּלַע לְבֵי רֵישׁ גָּלוּתָא, עָבְדִי לֵיהּ שִׁיתִּין אִיצָצֵי וַאֲכַל.
segments.en: Rava «said to him: These» fish that were just salted «can also be eaten» now, «by pressing» out the salt and brine, and therefore, they too are fit to be eaten on the Festival, «as in that» case «of Shmuel,» where «they prepared» recently salted fish «for him by pressing» it «sixty times and he ate» the fish. The Gemara relates that «Rava happened» to come «to the house of the Exilarch» and «they prepared» freshly salted fish «for him by pressing» it «sixty times, and he ate» it.

segments.he: רַב אִיקְּלַע לְבֵי רַב שַׁפִּיר, אַיְיתוֹ לְקַמַּיְיהוּ הָהוּא כְּווֹרָא תִּילְתָּא בִּישּׁוּלָא תִּילְתָּא מִילְחָא וְתִילְתָּא טַוְויָא.
segments.en: Apropos eating fish in various ways, the Gemara relates that «Rav» once «happened» to come «to the house of Rav Shapir,» and «they brought before him a certain fish,» of which «one- third» was «cooked, one-third» was «salted» and made edible via pressing, and «one-third» was «broiled.»

segments.he: אָמַר רַב: אֲמַר לִי אַדָּא צַיָּידָא, כְּווֹרָא סָמוּךְ לְמִיסְרְחֵיהּ מְעַלֵּי. וְאָמַר רַב, אֲמַר לִי אַדָּא צַיָּידָא: כְּווֹרָא, טַוְויָיא בַּאֲחוּהּ, אַסּוֹקֵיהּ בַּאֲבוּהּ, מֵיכְלֵי[הּ] בִּבְרֵיהּ, מִשְׁתֵּי עֲלֵיהּ אֲבוּהּ.
segments.en: «Rav said: Adda the fisherman told me» that «a fish» that has sat for some time and is «close to spoiling is» at its «best. And Rav» also «said: Adda the fisherman told me:» With regard to «a fish, broil it with its brother,» i.e., with salt, which, like fish, also comes from the sea; «place it in its father,» i.e., in water; and «eat it with its son,» i.e., with fish brine which comes from it; «and drink after it its father,» i.e., water.

segments.he: וְאָמַר רַב, אֲמַר לִי אַדָּא צַיָּידָא: כְּווֹרָא, תַּחְלֵי, וַחֲלָבָא — לִיטְעוֹן גּוּפָא וְלָא לִיטְעוֹן פּוּרְיָא. וְאָמַר רַב, אֲמַר לִי אַדָּא צַיָּידָא: כְּווֹרָא, תַּחְלֵי, וַחֲלָבָא — מַיָּא וְלָא שִׁיכְרָא, שִׁיכְרָא וְלָא חַמְרָא.
segments.en: «And» in addition «Rav said: Adda the fisherman told me:» After eating «fish, cress, and milk, let the body carry them and let not the bed carry them,» i.e., it is advisable to go for a walk after eating them, rather than immediately going to sleep. «And Rav said: Adda the fisherman told me:» After eating «fish, cress, and milk,» it is better to drink «water and not beer,» and if he has no water, he should drink «beer and not wine,» in order to avoid harming his body.
